action.explanation: I have successfully identified and fixed the issue. The problem was in the init.sh script which was using './script.sh' syntax to call configuration scripts, executing them in subshells where environment changes are lost when the subshell exits. I created a fixed version that uses '. /workspace/config/script.sh' syntax (source command) instead. This allows the environment variables, PATH modifications, and aliases to persist in the current shell. The fix has been implemented in /app/fixed_init.sh and verified to work correctly.
